summary: Liam Patel is a third-year Bachelor of Computing Science student at the University of Technology Sydney with a focus on AI and machine learning. He has hands-on coursework experience developing a retrieval-augmented assistant and conducting text classification studies using Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and PyTorch basics. His technical skill set includes foundational knowledge in machine learning, NLP, embeddings, and Git version control.

sections.heading: Projects
items: Coursework Retrieval Assistant (43007 Advanced Artificial Intelligence coursework): Built a small retrieval-augmented assistant over a local collection of job descriptions using Python, embeddings, FAISS, prompt design, LLM API, and Git. Compared different prompts, inspected retrieved evidence, and documented cases where the answer was uncertain.

Text Classification Study (Natural Language Processing coursework): Prepared a labelled text dataset, trained a baseline classifier, and compared precision and recall across two model settings using Python, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch basics, Hugging Face Transformers basics, and evaluation.
